blocks.html: At Acacia Escalades, location isn’t just the premium but its amenities are equally essential to ensure the heartening comforts of its newly moved-in residents. Located in the heart of bustling Pasig City, at Calle Industria cor. Amang Rodriguez Avenue in Manggahan, the early buyers have fitted their spacious units after the turnover was started last 2016. Meanwhile, the new residents are assured that they’ve made a sound investment because of Acacia Escalades’ proximity to various prominent corporate addresses, schools, hospitals, and even places of worship. It’s only five minutes away, for instance, from Eastwood; about a 20-minute drive from the Ortigas business district; about an hour’s drive away from Makati, BGC, and Quezon City. Notable schools like Ateneo, Miriam, and UP, are also less than 30 minutes away. But while unit owners are appreciating the convenience and mobility at this age when going through the metro’s heavy traffic is a real struggle, and when young families and millennials are valuing work-life balance more than ever, Acacia Escalades made sure to bring in more pleasingly unexpected conveniences. The modern Filipiniana-inspired architecture of this mid-rise development gives residents a sense of place as the structure’s wooden beams, roofing imitating old brick tiles, and balconahes (balconies) offer impressions of the elegant Spanish colonial houses of yore. On the ground floor, the row of establishments like supermarket, bank, drugstore, restaurants, and cafes, are providing an assuring presence that one’s modern-day needs are truly taken cared of in this emerging neighborhood. Nurturing relationships The minute a resident arrives at the Drop-Off Area at the third level main entrance, the homey ambiance pervades as landscaped pocket gardens now thriving with tropical flora becomes a welcoming sight. Inside, the Filipino home concept is palpable as local touches like wooden wall accents and framed images of charming destinations enhance that familiar and cozy feel. The lounges by the main residential lobby invites cordial meetings as tenants can receive their guests as both sit back and relax at its elegant modern-tropical seats and tables. This hospitable mood is echoed as well at the ground floor retail lobby and fourth floor lobby, which leads to the outdoor amenities. Still on the third floor, the Function Hall that can accommodate up to 100 people can be divided into three segments. Here, families can celebrate their special milestones, hold reunions with relatives, or ask office colleagues or business partners to come over for special meetings or small workshops. These amenities simply authenticate Acacia Escalades’ vision and call to “Nurture Your Future Growth.” According to Kristynne Tan, Robinsons Communities Marketing Manager, “Acacia Escalades was really designed as a first home for start-up families and those who are just starting their careers. The amenities were envisioned to encourage its market, including new parents, for instance, to raise their small children while they pursue their professional lives or growing startup enterprises as well.” That feeling of belonging to a village is further enhanced by other Acacia Escalades facilities that offer relaxing sanctuaries for uplifting one’s body and soul. There is a Gym equipped with the latest exercise machines and, soon, a Dance Studio, at Building B. The vibrancy of urban living at Acacia Escalades, however, also asserts its vision of providing a gentle place where children can play, explore, and generally just be themselves. Each of Building A’s 11 residential floors have naturally lighted spacious corridors where toddlers can freely take their small steps or ride their very first trikes. On the Fourth Floor, parents and their little ones will delight in their newfound community’s Swimming Pool and Children’s Playground. And, yes, they can even enjoy gentle breezes in the morning or stare at the stars at night at the building’s lush Landscaped Areas. Residents will also appreciate Ring Rob Concierge, the country’s first and only residential online service request platform. Chores like doing the laundry, maintenance of air conditioner, or cleaning one’s unit becomes easier with this app’s dependable list of services. But Acacia Escalades residents will find Ring Rob Concierge most helpful when they have their units renovated. Ring Rob can turn an Acacia bare unit into a full functional unit in just 45 days and for as low as Php9,500.00 per square meter. Residents will just have to sit back and relax and let Ring Rob Concierge do the rest. Beyond merely providing creature comforts for urban dwellers, Acacia Escalades offers family-friendly facilities and amenities that push for a truly comfortable modern lifestyle, putting the values of a Filipino home at the forefront, and turning this ideal as an affordable proposition for home seekers. About Acacia Escalades Acacia Escalades lies on a 10,477 square meter property in Barangay Manggahan in Pasig City. It is a two-building property with Building B set for construction soon. All buildings will have Studio, One-Bedroom, and Two-Bedroom units. This Robinsons Communities mixed-use development is a project of Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC).
